name: pacing rhythm
notes: Chapter XXI (Z95.0 presence of pacemaker) not Chapter IX

name: prolonged QT interval
notes: interval measurement finding not disease (R94.31); LQTS itself would be I45.81 but this label is the generic finding

name: myocardial infarction
notes: generic MI could be acute(I21) or old(I25); CSN's regional-wall labels read as acute ECG patterns

name: left ventricular hypertrophy
notes: voltage-criteria ECG finding; I51.7 cardiomegaly is the conventional but weak crosswalk bucket

name: Brugada pattern
notes: sometimes coded I42.8 (cardiomyopathy) instead; genuinely ambiguous

name: complete left bundle branch block
notes: I44.7 (scored equivalent to 164909002 in PhysioNet Challenge 2021)
